title: Order to Establish a Sensitive Area and Objectives, Mugaha Marsh, 2001
madeUnder: Forest Practices Code Act s. 5; continued as a Land Act s. 93.4 objective by Land Act s. 93.8 (sensitive area)
transcribedFrom: signed PDF, scanned; read from the page images

provisions.heading: Sensitive area established
quotes: to Establish a Sensitive Area and Objectives File Number MOF 12550-20 Mugaha Marsh MELP 47000-20 Mugaha Marsh Pursuant to

provisions.heading: Maintain the current mix of forest and wetland habitat
quotes: Maintain the current mix of forest and wetland habitat for resident wildlife species.
The following objectives are established as sensitive area objectives Effective January 1, 2002:

provisions.heading: Allow wildlife monitoring and research
quotes: 2) Allow for wildlife monitoring and research activities within the sensitive area that do not conflict with the other

provisions.heading: Maintain the current range of recreational uses
quotes: Maintain the current range of recreational uses and opportunities.

provisions.heading: Reasonable precautions for users' safety
quotes: Provide reasonable precautions for the safety of users of the area.

provisions.heading: Boundary map
quotes: The boundaries of the Mugaha Marsh Sensitive Area are shown on the attached 1:50,000 scale map dated October 24, 2001.

provisions.heading: Strategies expected in operational plans
quotes: Under Section 41(1) of the Forest Practices Code of British Columbia Act (the Act)
I have reviewed the strategies in Section 3.0 of the Mugaha Marsh Sensitive Area Plan and believe they are relevant to
I therefore recommend that these strategies be considered and incorporated into operational plans and amendments where

provisions.heading: Manage Mugaha Marsh water levels within BC Hydro's licence
quotes: - Within the limits of BC Hydro's water license, manage water levels on Mugaha Marsh to maintain riparian vegetative cover.

provisions.heading: Harvest at most 10% of the commercial forest in any 10 years
quotes: - Limit timber harvesting within the sensitive area to a maximum of 10% of the commercial forest area
Herbicides are considered incompatible.

provisions.heading: 100 m unlogged reserve beside all lakes and wetlands
quotes: - Maintain a minimum 100m wide unlogged reserve zone adjacent to all lakes and wetlands
Pesticides are considered incompatible.

provisions.heading: Native regrowth on disturbed areas
quotes: -On all disturbed areas, utilize practices that encourage the regrowth of native shrubs and other vegetation of high habitat

provisions.heading: Limited habitat improvements
quotes: -Allow for limited habitat improvements for birds and wildlife within the context of maintaining general habitat values

provisions.heading: Research and monitoring
quotes: - Encourage non-destructive identification and documentation of all living species in the area. - Encourage the continuation

provisions.heading: Wildlife viewing without reducing habitat
quotes: - Enhance opportunities for wildlife viewing without reducing wildlife and bird habitat.

provisions.heading: Permanent roads only where mapped; others temporary
quotes: Permanent roads are limited to those identified on the map.
Any other roads are to be kept to a minimum, considered temporary and revegetated in order to limit motorized access.

provisions.heading: Motor vehicles on existing roads only
quotes: Limit the use of motor vehicles (including ATV's and snowmobiles) to existing roads only.

provisions.heading: Signs cautioning road users
quotes: Post signs cautioning road users of slow traffic and pedestrians along the road through Mugaha Marsh.

provisions.heading: Research schedule to the road user
quotes: -Regular research users to provide Chico Wood Fibre with a schedule of their activities.

provisions.heading: Implementation and review
quotes: All provisions of the higher level plan take effect as of the date specified in the attached order.
A statement of higher level plan transition is therefore not required.
